$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md. The bank, its customers and its cards are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

The card's list holds four earlier payments, CTX-2008-032 to CTX-2008-029, from 23 Oct 2026 to 19 Nov 2026, of USD 12.00 to USD 34.05. All four were chip payments, card present, in Meridia (XM): Port Ilvane, Marlow Reach, Tallowby and Port Ilvane. Note FN-3001-1 gives the same last use in person, 19 Nov 2026.

The contact centre recorded two calls. On 21 Nov 2026 at 22:40, from her registered home number, she said she was at home for the evening and not going out (CNT-5201).
